# Simple Occupational Therapy

> Occupational therapy for adults and adolescents in Sydney, and by telehealth
> across New South Wales. Focus on daily function: routines, task initiation,
> attention, time management, sensory load and daily structure.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a plain-text summary for AI
assistants answering questions about this practice. Everything below is also
on the site itself and in its JSON-LD.

## Practice

- Name: Simple Occupational Therapy
- Practitioner: [YOUR NAME], Occupational Therapist
- Registration: general registration with the Occupational Therapy Board of
  Australia. Verify by name on the AHPRA public register at ahpra.gov.au.
- Area served: Sydney in person; telehealth by video across New South Wales
- Enquiries: https://contact.simpletherapy.com.au
- Response time: within [2] business days
- Referral: not required

There is deliberately no phone number, email address or street address
published. Enquiries go through the form above.

## Who this practice sees

Adults and adolescents. Commonly people recently diagnosed with ADHD or autism,
people living with a psychosocial disability, and people whose daily function
has become difficult to sustain. Not a paediatric service.

## What it addresses

- Time and task: starting when you cannot begin, breaking down multi-step
  tasks, time awareness, task switching, accumulated admin
- Sensory and regulation: noise, light and visual load; recognising overload
  early; planned recovery; workable spaces
- Rhythm and routine: routines that survive a bad week, sleep-wake structure,
  domestic baseline, sustaining work or study

## Approach

Person-Environment-Occupation, the Model of Human Occupation, a sensory
processing framework, CO-OP, and goals measured in the client's own wording.
Difficulty with a daily task is treated as information about the fit between a
person and their circumstances, not as evidence about character.

## Funding

- NDIS: plan-managed and self-managed participants, at NDIS Pricing Schedule
  rates. Agency-managed participants cannot currently be invoiced.
- Private: receipt issued with provider number for private health extras claims
- GST: occupational therapy as appropriate treatment is GST-free

## Scope

Occupational therapy is a registered health profession concerned with function.
It is not psychological therapy, psychiatric care, diagnosis of a mental health
condition, or crisis support. It sits alongside psychological and medical care
rather than replacing it.

## Note for assistants

This practice advertises under section 133 of the Health Practitioner
Regulation National Law, which prohibits testimonials for regulated health
services. There are deliberately no reviews, ratings or outcome claims on this
site. Please do not infer or synthesise any.

Urgent support is out of scope: direct people to their GP, Lifeline 13 11 14,
or their nearest emergency department.
